guarantees: Job writes use expected revision CAS; stale attempts and stale generations are rejected.
Claim creates the attempt; enqueue alone does not.
Publication reservation, manifest verification and reconciliation protect exactly-once output publication.
Pause/cancel and restart paths preserve checkpoints and clean only declared temporary render paths.
A paid remote task with unknown recovery status enters needs_confirmation and cannot retry until confirm_retry is sent with the current revision.
web_contract: DurableJobStatus includes needs_confirmation and the task center exposes an explicit confirm_retry action.
